text: Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen jaabori ɓe: Ko goonga, men wonaali si wanaa ɓanndinke yeru mon. Ko woni tun, ɗum hollaa hiɗen nannda e kala huunde. Alla no hertinira neeminirgol on Mo O muuyi e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, O suɓoo e maɓɓe Nulaaɓe e yimɓe ɓen. Menen, haananaa men nde men addanta on hujja mo ɗaɓɓoton, si wanaa e duŋayee Alla, men hattanaaka addugol ɗum, ko Alla tun woni hattanɗo e ɗum. Ko e Alla tun woni ko gomɗimɓe ɓe Mo ɓen fawatoo e fiyakuuji maɓɓe ɗin fow.
